title: Bladed
summary: BLA'DED, participle passive Having a blade or blades. It may be used of blade in the sense of a leaf, a spire, or the cutting part of an instrument. 1. In mineralogy, composed of long and narrow plate

inlines.v: BLA'DED, participle passive Having a blade or blades. It may be used of blade in the sense of a leaf, a spire, or the cutting part of an instrument. 1. In mineralogy, composed of long and narrow plates, like the blade of a knife.
